reporting_rules: Freeze both selector wordings, both executor prompts, the same-snapshot single-pass baseline, all 96 inherited contexts, messages, hashes, model-specific order, metrics, and gates before any response call.
Both selectors use identical binary actions and differ in wording and ASK-versus-EXPLAIN presentation order; each must pass independently.
Non-selector calls and selector prompts are target-invariant; no message may expose the held-out human target action.
Generate both counterfactual executor responses for every context and model before composition; never condition provider calls on an observed selector outcome.
Compose each selector with the already generated executor response for its parsed action; invalid selector outputs remain invalid and cannot be repaired or excluded.

Use question-mark realization as the registered binary ASK-versus-EXPLAIN endpoint; report the three four-way human-action classifiers as secondary measurement-sensitive outcomes without a success gate.
Randomize each model in exact ten-stratum blocks crossing two human targets by five call types.
Treat contexts as bootstrap clusters and the five models as a fixed panel; report every model and failed gate.
The human next action is an observed reference, not a uniquely optimal teaching decision, and no endpoint measures learning.
Do not change models, contexts, prompts, calls, parser, metrics, thresholds, routes, or exclusions after inspecting responses.
